# The Dry District

In a dry district, the water under the ground sinks lower every year. Farmers can grow sugarcane, which needs a lot of water but earns well and supplies the sugar mill. Or they can grow millets and pulses, which need little water.

The district chooses sugarcane.

**Predict:** What does this choice give up?

options.text: Only the seeds, fertiliser and labour that any crop would need.
Water that could have stayed underground, and healthier soil.
Nothing, because the crop that earns the most has no cost.
